key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate, mostly entire to lobed, hairy; lower leaves often spoon-shaped or lobed.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Large showy heads with red/maroon-centered rays tipped yellow; disk reddish to purplish.

key_traits.label: Phyllaries
key_traits.text: In several series, often spreading or reflexed, sometimes somewhat leafy.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Cypselae with a pappus of scales/aristate awns.

key_traits.label: Best field traits
key_traits.text: red-and-yellow heads; hairy foliage; showy blanketflower look; flip the head over and inspect the spreading/reflexed phyllaries

key_traits.label: Joey field note
key_traits.text: Joey physically flips a Gaillardia pulchella head over in the Edwards Plateau video and points out the elongated, spiky phyllaries—an especially useful structural cue beyond flower color.
